title: Olapa-MCoT: Enhancing the Chinese Mathematical Reasoning Capability of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2312.17535v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the past two years, the outstanding performance of ChatGPT in multilingual and multitasking has led to large language models (LLMs) attracting widespread attention. However, restricted by expensive costs, many studies have to focus on the ability of only one major language. How can we quickly improve the model's capabilities in new languages without reducing its original capabilities under limited data and computing power? In this work, we focus on improving the Chinese mathematical reasoning capability based on Llama-2-13B, which is weak in Chinese mathematical reasoning. We proposed the Mathematical Chain of Thought method (Olapa-MCoT). First, we propose Similarity RRHF (SimRRHF), which adds the constraint of model optimization direction by introducing similarity loss based on RRHF. translated_title: Olapa-MCoT：提升大语言模型中文数学推理能力的方法
translated_abstract: 在过去两年中，ChatGPT在多语言和多任务方面的出色表现使得大语言模型（LLMs）受到广泛关注。然而，由于高昂的成本限制，许多研究不得不专注于单一主要语言的能力。在有限的数据和计算能力下，如何在不降低模型原有能力的情况下快速提升其在新语言中的能力？在这项工作中，我们专注于提升Llama-2-13B的中文数学推理能力，该模型在中文数学推理方面表现较弱。我们提出了数学思维链方法（Olapa-MCoT）。首先，我们提出了相似性RRHF（SimRRHF），该方法通过在RRHF基础上引入相似性损失，增加了模型优化方向的约束。此外，我们设计了新颖的错误数据再学习（IDRL）方法，以提高模型学习困难知识的能力。该...
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Olapa-MCoT的方法，通过SimRRHF和IDRL两种新技术，在有限资源和数据下有效提升了大语言模型的中文数学推理能力，同时保持原有语言能力不退化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Olapa-MCoT, which enhances the Chinese mathematical reasoning capability of LLMs through novel SimRRHF and IDRL techniques, achieving significant improvement without degrading original language abilities under limited resources.
